title: se-implementation-scratchpad-orchid-trust
body:
SE implementation scratchpad - Orchid Trust (personal)
---------------------------------------------------
Owner: Sofia Martinez (solutions-engineering)
Last modified: 2026-03-03
Context: PoC -> staging -> prod migration for Orchid Trust. Main ask: low-latency chat + embeddings for ledger search, must support VPC private deployment later.

Meeting notes (2026-02-24 sync)
- Met w/ product and infra on compliance checklist (Priya, Ethan).
- Primary concerns: data residency, KMS integration, audit logs retention (7 years?), network egress rules.
- Agreement: start with hosted API + model pinning for initial rollout, then Dedicated if latency/cost requires.
- Action: get access to their AWS account role + ephemeral credentials for validation (asked customer to open support ticket).

Top-level To-dos (personal)
- [ ] Finish deployment runbook draft for onboarding (due 2026-03-06)
- [ ] Validate IAM role from Orchid Trust (pending customer ticket)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key policy for audit team (talk to security)
- [ ] Run token-cost estimate for typical conversation (10k monthly users)
- [ ] Add prompt set for quality regression tests (start with 20 seed prompts)

Technical checklist / quick commands
- Staging cluster: redwood-staging-us-east-1 (notes below)
- Model: redwood/ggml-moderate-1 (quantized) for initial; fallback to open/llama-7b if needed
- Sample API test:
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
    -d '{"input":"hello"}' 
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  (use --stream for latency profiling)

- KV cache enabled on staging, set prefix_ttl=600s for chat to reduce tokens
- Suggested batch config: target_mean_batch_size=8 for their expected qps pattern (see perf-notes in PR 786)

Config notes (things to set in customer config)
- routes:
  - route_id: orchid-chat-prod
    model: redwood/ggml-moderate-1@v1.2.0
    rollout: canary=10%, stable=90%
    fallback: redwood/llama-7b-quantized
    batching: auto, max_latency_ms=120
- kms: use-customer-kms: true (placeholder, need key ARN)
- logging: level=info + token_level_costs=true (send logs to customer S3 bucket)

Open questions / risks
- Compliance: do they require FIPS endpoints? If yes, escalate to security.
- Data residency: Which regions (ap-south or eu-west)? They said NA/EU only.
- Cost: Embedding use looks heavy - need to propose caching layer or rate limiting.

Follow-ups for next week
- Sync with Priya on KMS policy draft (assignable doc) - Priya to share template by 2026-03-05
- Ethan to prototype batch size knob in staging and share latency numbers (target p50 < 120ms for chat responses)
- Create prompt eval set and add to CI: repo -> evaluations/orchid-trust/seed-prompts.md

Notes for runbook (outline)
1) Pre-onboarding checklist (contract, IAM, KMS, regions)
2) Staging validation (deploy route, smoke tests, perf tests, cost estimate)
3) Canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100% with SLO gates)
4) Post-deploy (monitoring dashboards, alerts, escalation paths)
5) Private/Dedicated migration checklist (data plane ops, network, on-prem considerations)

Quick links referenced above
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-2345
- Confluence onboarding page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Orchid+Trust+Onboarding
- Runtime PR with perf tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/786

Random notes / scratch (throwaway)
- If customer wants embeddings-only for search, consider hybrid: offline index + on-demand embeddings for freshness.
- Possible follow-on: dedicated dedicated-gpu pool if sustained qps > 150 rps for chat.

End of scratchpad.
